name: sample
use_when: Use for calm editorial product pages with a clear primary action.

guidance.character: Restrained, warm, and editorial, with measured contrast and generous space.
usage: Keep the page ground warm and neutral; reserve rust for the primary action and links.
composition: Use a clear title, short supporting copy, and one dominant action per opening section.
adaptations: On narrow screens, preserve the text hierarchy and reduce outer gutters before reducing body size.
